summary: Frontend-only landing page for Meridian & Rowe tested end-to-end at desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). All 8 requested features passed: hero, sticky nav, CTA smooth scrolls, all content sections render (handle-everything, results w/ $5.2M/$1.2M/$3.8M, journey 0-2, testimonials 0-2, final-push, footer), form submit replaces form with confirmation 'We've got it from here', HTML5 required blocks empty submit, no console errors, images load, mobile viewport usable.
critical_code_review_comments: Mobile viewport (390px) hides nav-cta-button (only phone link visible in nav). Not in the requested test list explicitly for mobile, so acceptable, but confirm this is intentional.

Final-push headline 'Don't Let Them Run Out the Clock' verified visually via final-push-section rendering; text likely uses styled spans (strict text match failed but section rendered). Consider consolidating to a single data-testid for the headline.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All data-testid selectors work as documented. Framer-motion whileInView reveals fine with ~300-500ms wait after scroll_into_view_if_needed. Form submission is client-only and swaps form for form-confirmation node (case-review-form is removed from DOM after submit).
